issues.detail: The Greek verb 'ομοιωσω' (omoiōsō) is in the future tense, but it is used here as a question or a rhetorical statement of intent. More importantly, the Vietnamese 'sánh... với gì?' (compare... with what?) changes the structure of the Greek sentence. The Greek 'τινι ομοιωσω' literally means 'with what [shall I] liken/compare', but the Vietnamese phrasing 'Ta sẽ sánh... với gì?' shifts the focus to a question about the object of comparison, whereas the Greek is a statement of the action of likening.
